one_month_reasoning: No company earnings expected inside the window: MP filed Q3 2025 results on 2025-11-06 and Q2 2026 on 2026-08-06 (EDGAR 8-K list), so Q3 2026 most likely lands ~Nov 5, after Oct 30 (some aggregators guess Oct 29; I give that ~25%). The main scheduled macro/policy event, the 2026-11-10 lapse of China's one-year suspension of its October-2025 rare-earth export controls, is also just outside the window, but positioning ahead of it could move the theme either way (escalation headlines have historically lifted MP; the June 2026 Chinese blacklisting of MP hurt it). The stock has fallen 21% in a month on a sector-wide sell-off (REMX -17%), and short interest is high (~23% of float), so both a reflex bounce and continued theme liquidation are plausible. With no clear edge I use a near-symmetric lognormal centred just below spot (median ~$47.0) with monthly vol ~21% (74%/3.5).

fair_value.method: Blend of 22x NTM EBITDA at Sep-2027 (~$280M) plus net cash on ~238M diluted shares ($30), a 2030 steady-state EBITDA ($750M x 14x, discounted 3 years at 11%) DCF-lite ($36), and the low end of the sell-side target range ($57) as a strategic-premium cross-check; weights 0.35/0.35/0.30 give ~$40.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: NTM EBITDA at Sep-2027 ~$280M x 22x = EV $6.2B; + ~$0.65B net cash (ex-converts) at Sep-2027 = $6.85B equity; / ~238M diluted shares = ~$29-30

inputs_detail.value: $28.5M in Q2 2026 (~$114M annualized); Materials segment $32.5M on 1,006t NdPr sold

inputs_detail.derivation: NdPr sales scaling from ~4,000t/yr to ~5,500t/yr run rate by late 2027, realized ~$110/kg incl. PPA top-up (DoW $110/kg floor; spot ~$97-108), Materials margin rising from 29% to ~40% -> ~$240M; Magnetics (Independence GM ramp from Q4-26, 10X not yet contributing much) ~$80M; corporate ~-$45M.

Stock currently trades ~190x TTM EBITDA (stockanalysis); third-party fair-value models (GF Value $40, Simply Wall St narrative $51) imply the strategic premium is already rich; 22x is a premium-to-miners, scarcity-adjusted multiple for a business still in ramp.

inputs_detail.input: Net cash at Sep-2027 (treating in-the-money 2030 converts as equity)
inputs_detail.derivation: Cash+ST investments $1.453B at 6/30/26 less non-convert debt (~$0.19B of the $0.935B LT debt) = ~$1.26B; Q2 capex alone was $230M and H1 cash capex $308M with 10X under construction, so I assume ~$0.6B net burn over the next 5 quarters.

178.1M basic + 39.7M from 2030 notes (conversion ~$18.84, deep in the money) + 13.3M DoW Series A preferred (conv. $30.03) + ~4.1M net from 11.2M DoW warrants at $30.03 (treasury method at $47) + 2.3M RSU/PSU.

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: 2030 steady-state EBITDA $750M x 14x exit = $10.5B EV in 2030; discounted 3 yrs at 11% = $7.7B; + ~$0.65B net cash; less ~$0.3B further capex; / 238M shares = ~$34-36

inputs_detail.derivation: Upstream ~10kt NdPr at the $110/kg floor (~$1.1B revenue at ~45% margin = ~$500M) + magnetics including the DoW-guaranteed $140M/yr 10X EBITDA and Independence/GM/Apple volumes ~$250M; assumes 10X executes on time, which is the key risk.
Mature, floor-protected, partly contracted cash flows deserve a utility-plus industrial multiple, not today's growth premium.
High-beta (74% realized vol), pre-profit project company; equity cost ~11% with execution risk handled in the scenarios.

inputs_detail.value: $110/kg NdPr through 2035; 30% upside share once 10X runs

methods.name: other
methods.inputs: Sell-side cross-check: low end of current target range (Freedom Broker $57 Hold, JPM $60 OW) vs consensus ~$74-76; captures the strategic/national-security premium the market has paid for years

inputs_detail.value: Freedom $57, JPM $60 (cut from $75), Barclays $65, Needham $73, DA Davidson $82; mean ~$74
inputs_detail.derivation: I use the low end rather than the mean because targets have been cut repeatedly since June and lag price.

bear.story: Theme deflates further: Independence/GM commercial shipments slip past Q4-26 or yields disappoint, 10X schedule/cost overruns, capex keeps draining cash (cash already down from $1.83B to $1.45B in six months) forcing an equity or convert raise in 2027; China extends its export-control pause and NdPr stays below the floor so earnings are visibly 'subsidy' (PPA income ~16% of revenue+PPA); bill-and-hold revenue (47% of Q2 revenue) and rising receivables draw scrutiny; stock re-rates toward ~20x near-term EBITDA.

base.story: Ramp proceeds roughly on plan: commercial magnet shipments start, NdPr volumes grow, EBITDA run rate ~$250-300M by late 2027, but the premium multiple compresses as the story becomes execution, insider selling continues, and the stock trades sideways near today's level within a wide range.

bull.story: China reinstates/escalates export controls after Nov 10 2026, ex-China NdPr and heavy rare-earth premiums widen, new DoW/allied or Apple-type offtakes, 10X ahead of schedule; strategic scarcity premium returns toward the $100 52-week high.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$28 (just under the $30.03 DoW warrant/preferred conversion price and ~40% below spot) the market would be pricing MP like a floor-protected miner with no magnet franchise, which most likely means a real fundamental break (failed GM/10X magnet ramp, a dilutive capital raise, an adverse change to DoW support, or an accounting problem), not ordinary 74%-vol noise.

catalysts.event: Q3 2026 results: first read on Q4 GM commercial magnet shipments, capex and cash burn
Expiry of China's one-year suspension of October-2025 rare-earth export controls (renewal or lapse)
Start of commercial magnet shipments to GM from Independence (guided)
Possible China Rare Earth Group takeover of Shenghe (holds ~3% of MP) and any resulting block sale
Further CEO 10b5-1 sales (>$58M sold Apr-Jun 2026) and potential capital raise as cash falls

key_uncertainties: Whether Independence magnets pass GM qualification and ship commercially on time (guided Q4 2026, after multiple prior slips)
10X facility cost and schedule; size of the 2027 cash burn and whether new equity/converts are needed
China export-control path after Nov 10 2026 and its effect on NdPr pricing and on the scarcity premium
Quality of revenue: bill-and-hold revenue of $51.3M (47%) in Q2 2026 and trade receivables up from $14.6M to $40.4M
Durability of DoW support (price floor, offtake, preferred) across political cycles
Short interest ~23% of float can drive violent squeezes in either direction
reasoning: Skeptic lane. Fundamentals: Q2 2026 revenue $108.5M (+89%), adjusted EBITDA $28.5M, but GAAP net loss -$20M, PPA (government price-floor) income $17.6M was ~62% of adjusted EBITDA, and $51.3M of revenue was bill-and-hold with receivables nearly tripling, so reported improvement is partly policy- and timing-driven. Capex is heavy ($230M in Q2) and cash fell $380M in H1 to $1.45B. Fully diluted share count is ~238-245M (2030 notes deep in the money, DoW preferred and warrants at $30.03), so the true equity value is ~$11B+ vs ~$8.2B basic market cap, ~190x TTM EBITDA. CEO sold >$58M of stock at $64-71 in Apr-Jun 2026; China blacklisted MP in June; Shenghe (3% holder) may be absorbed by China Rare Earth Group; sell-side targets cut repeatedly (JPM $75->$60, Needham $81->$73, Barclays $69->$65). Weighing honestly: the DoW $110/kg floor, $140M guaranteed 10X EBITDA, Apple/GM contracts and net cash give a hard-ish floor, and geopolitical escalation (Nov 10 control expiry) is a real upside catalyst, so I don't forecast a collapse. My blended fair value is ~$40 (pure fundamental methods $30-36, sell-side low-end $57 cross-check). Distribution: lognormal with median ~$44 (modest drift toward fair value) and ~62% vol (a bit below the realized 74% given the policy floor), with a fat right tail for China-escalation scenarios. Research limited to ~15 queries; Seeking Alpha and Fintel pages were blocked (403), so short-interest is from stockanalysis and the SA downgrade is cited only as a lead. No option data was consulted.
